title: Counting step
statement: For a list state $S$, if its second component is empty, the step returns $S$. Otherwise, writing its defaulted pair decomposition as $(A,B)$, the step encodes the pair consisting of the binary sum of the encoding of $(A,[	ext{true}])$ and the list obtained by dropping the first element of $B$.
